rule: NeRF-Object-Removal protocol of 2026-10-17 (D1-D6). Mapping = frames [0, split_start) every stride-th frame, update = frames [split_end, N) every update_stride-th frame. stride: the stride whose mapping frame count is nearest 125 (scripts/check_nor.py suggested_stride, D4); update_stride = stride (scripts/eval_change_nor.py default). Keyframes: run_mapping.py's defaults (drop a frame < 5 cm AND < 5 deg from the last kept one), the same rule for both parts; n_*_keyframes are the counts it keeps (aligned poses, checked by scripts/nor_tab2.py merge). align: the D3 update-pose alignment (scripts/align_nor.py), applied to the update part in every scene (it moves no mapping frame, so only scripts/eval_change_nor.py reads it). Validation 001-004, test 005-016 (D6, run once). Paths: ply = the 3DGS map (scripts/fit_gs.py), field = the mapping-only field (scripts/run_mapping.py); scripts/nor_tab2.sh builds both. PROTOCOL CHANGE fixed on 2026-10-18 before any method ran: no D3 alignment (it lowered the photometric agreement of update and map frames in 6 well-aligned scenes and left 1.3 cm in 012); instead, a scene whose before->after median depth error (scripts/check_nor.py, object masks left out) exceeds 1 cm is excluded: 012 (3.54 cm) and 016 (2.50 cm), both test scenes. Test N = 10.
